script_text: Stop! Scorpio, the stars are screaming at you right now. Pluto, your ruling planet, is forming a tense square to Mars in your 1st House, igniting a surge of assertive energy. Meanwhile, Venus is sextiling your natal Jupiter in the 7th House, offering a subtle boost to your partnerships. Mercury also trines your natal Moon in the 4th House, sharpening your emotional intuition. If you're single, this fiery aspect draws you to bold, charismatic partners who challenge your intensity. If you're in a relationship, watch for power struggles as Pluto squares Mars, demanding honest communication. Your 10th House of career is lit by a Sun‑Mercury conjunction, signaling a chance to showcase your expertise and secure a promotion. Financially, the 2nd House receives a supportive trine from Saturn, encouraging disciplined budgeting and long‑term investments. Avoid impulsive decisions today, as the Mars‑Pluto square can trigger reckless actions. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
